dyads.definition: A blocking dyad is (game, would-be completer, holder, colour group) with at least one acceptance-legal offer under which the completer would newly hold the whole group using deed(s) from the holder. An offer completing a group for each party contributes two dyads.

holder_cash.definition: author_only: acceptance-legal offers under which only the author would complete a colour group; the recipient holds the completing deed(s). Cash is the recipient's cash in the delivered state before responding.
